name: The Matrix
install: if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else bash repos/the-matrix/.cursor/install.sh; fi

terminals.name: gateway
terminals.command: cd "$([ -d .venv ] && echo . || echo repos/the-matrix)" && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m gateway.server
terminals.description: The Matrix gateway (REST + WebSocket) on http://localhost:18790 — /health, /status, /chat, /api/v1/capabilities
